remarks: Pristine and sun-filled 2-bedroom, 1-bath first-floor unit on a quiet residential street! This one-level home features an open-concept, updated kitchen with a breakfast bar that flows seamlessly into a spacious living room. Both bedrooms offer generous closet space, complemented by a tasteful full bathroom. Enjoy your own private deck - perfect for summer BBQs! Additional highlights include in-unit laundry, hardwood floors throughout, reserved off-street parking, and all utilities included. Conveniently located near downtown, within walking distance to a popular restaurant, and just minutes to the Merritt Parkway, I-95, and the train station. Don't miss this incredible value!
